run_bm_fps: run the farthest point sampling benchmark comparing naive and optimized FPS across batch sizes and devices
run_benchmark_naive_fps: run the naive python farthest point sampling benchmark with small point clouds on cpu and cuda
run_benchmark_optimized_fps: run the optimized farthest point sampling benchmark with large point clouds up to 18384 points
review_bm_fps: review the bm_fps function to understand benchmark test case generation using itertools product
refactor_bm_fps: refactor the bm_fps benchmark to add new point cloud sizes or backend devices
